description: Add three new RL algorithms to rlqas-chem as specified in ideas_pool/RLQAS_Algorithm_Selection_Improved_20260428.md. Each algorithm must pass the acceptance system before being considered complete. Implement in priority order: P1 GiGPO → P2 Tree-GRPO → P3 Double-DQN.

userStories.title: GiGPO: Group-Relative Policy Optimization with Intra-Episode Credit Assignment
userStories.description: Implement GiGPOAgent — a step-level credit assignment variant of GRPO. Unlike GRPO which assigns a single advantage per episode, GiGPO computes per-step advantages using Monte Carlo returns and anchor-group normalization. This addresses the sparse reward problem common to all QAS tasks.
implementation: Architecture: same 2-layer MLP policy as GRPOAgent
Config keys: lr (3e-4), gamma (0.99), group_size (8), clip_range (0.2), entropy_coef (0.01), anchor_ratio (0.33)
Run one complete episode, return {states, actions, log_probs, rewards, final_energy}
Step 1 — Monte Carlo returns: G_t = sum_{k=t}^T gamma^{k-t} r_k
Step 2 — Subtract lightweight value baseline V(s_t) if value_net exists, else use mean(G)
anchor_size = max(1, T // 3)  # first anchor_ratio fraction of steps
For each episode i, for each step t:
Compute step_advantages for each via compute_step_advantages
Run train_one_group() repeatedly until total_timesteps reached
Call callback after each group if provided
save(path) / load(path): standard torch state_dict save/load
The UCCSearchController already supports any agent with learn()+act() interface.
No changes to controller needed — GiGPOAgent.train_one_group() is called via learn().
If UCCSearchController calls agent.learn(total_timesteps=N), GiGPOAgent must handle this.
acceptanceCriteria: bash rlqas_acceptance_system/run_acceptance.sh --agent gigppo exits with code 0
from rlqas_chem.rl import GiGPOAgent
from rlqas_chem.rl.agent_factory import AgentFactory; assert 'gigppo' in AgentFactory.supported_agents()
import rlqas_chem; r = rlqas_chem.search('H2', 0.74, ansatz_type='UCC', agent_type='gigppo', n_episodes=20); assert r['best_energy'] < -1.0
# --- GiGPO 算法机制专项验证 ---
# 1. step-level advantages 长度等于 episode 步数（不是标量）

from rlqas_chem.rl.gigpo_agent import GiGPOAgent; from rlqas_chem.search.ucc.environment import UCCSearchEnv; from rlqas_chem.molecule.processor import process_molecule; import numpy as np; mol = process_molecule('H2', 0.74, 'UCC'); env = UCCSearchEnv(mol, config={'max_excitations': 4}); agent = GiGPOAgent(env.observation_space, env.action_space, {}); ep = agent.collect_episode(env); advs = agent.compute_step_advantages(ep); assert len(advs) == len(ep['actions']), f'step advantages length {len(advs)} != episode length {len(ep["actions"])}'
# 2. 同一 episode 内各步优势值不全相同（步骤级别差异化，非复制标量）

from rlqas_chem.rl.gigpo_agent import GiGPOAgent; from rlqas_chem.search.ucc.environment import UCCSearchEnv; from rlqas_chem.molecule.processor import process_molecule; mol = process_molecule('H2', 0.74, 'UCC'); env = UCCSearchEnv(mol, config={'max_excitations': 6}); agent = GiGPOAgent(env.observation_space, env.action_space, {}); ep = agent.collect_episode(env); advs = agent.compute_step_advantages(ep); assert len(set(round(a, 6) for a in advs)) > 1 or len(advs) == 1, 'all step advantages are identical — anchor-group normalization may not be applied'
# 3. train_one_group 返回包含 mean_energy 和 best_energy 字段

from rlqas_chem.rl.gigpo_agent import GiGPOAgent; from rlqas_chem.search.ucc.environment import UCCSearchEnv; from rlqas_chem.molecule.processor import process_molecule; mol = process_molecule('H2', 0.74, 'UCC'); env = UCCSearchEnv(mol, config={'max_excitations': 4}); agent = GiGPOAgent(env.observation_space, env.action_space, {}); info = agent.train_one_group(env); assert 'mean_energy' in info and 'best_energy' in info, f'missing keys in train_one_group result: {list(info.keys())}'
# 4. 训练 5 个 group 后 best_energy 不高于初始（有学习趋势）

from rlqas_chem.rl.gigpo_agent import GiGPOAgent; from rlqas_chem.search.ucc.environment import UCCSearchEnv; from rlqas_chem.molecule.processor import process_molecule; mol = process_molecule('H2', 0.74, 'UCC'); env = UCCSearchEnv(mol, config={'max_excitations': 4}); agent = GiGPOAgent(env.observation_space, env.action_space, {}); first = agent.train_one_group(env)['best_energy']; [agent.train_one_group(env) for _ in range(4)]; last = agent.train_one_group(env)['best_energy']; assert last <= first + 0.5, f'best_energy did not improve after 5 groups: {first:.4f} -> {last:.4f}'

userStories.title: Tree-GRPO: Tree-based GRPO with Prefix Sharing and VQE Caching
userStories.description: Implement TreeGRPOAgent — a GRPO variant that exploits the deterministic prefix semantics of UCC operator sequences. Episodes sharing the same first k operators share the same quantum state, so their VQE results can be cached. This reduces VQE calls by 30-50% while discovering better operator orderings than greedy ADAPT-VQE. Only applicable to UCC (not HEA, since HEA parameters are randomly initialized).
implementation: Internal data: dict mapping tuple(operator_indices) -> float (VQE energy)
get(prefix: tuple) -> Optional[float]: return cached energy or None
put(prefix: tuple, energy: float): store energy for prefix
hits() -> int: number of cache hits
size() -> int: number of cached entries
Config keys: lr (3e-4), gamma (0.99), group_size (8), clip_range (0.2), entropy_coef (0.01)
At each step, current prefix = tuple(actions_so_far)
After env.step(), if done: cache prefix -> info['final_energy'] (if available in info)
Return {states, actions, log_probs, rewards, final_energy, cache_hits}
rewards = [-e for e in energies]  # lower energy = higher reward
return [(r - mean_r) / std_r for r in rewards]
Standard GRPO clipped objective at episode level (not step level)
For each episode i with advantage A_i:
For each (state, action, old_log_prob) in episode i:
Run train_one_group() repeatedly until total_timesteps reached
act(obs) -> Tuple[int, dict]: sample from policy
Note: prefix caching works best when env.step() exposes final_energy in info dict.
If info does not contain final_energy, fall back to episode reward as proxy.
Do NOT modify UCCSearchEnv — read info dict as-is and cache what is available.

from rlqas_chem.rl import TreeGRPOAgent
from rlqas_chem.rl.agent_factory import AgentFactory; assert 'tree_grpo' in AgentFactory.supported_agents()
import rlqas_chem; r = rlqas_chem.search('H2', 0.74, ansatz_type='UCC', agent_type='tree_grpo', n_episodes=20); assert r['best_energy'] < -1.0
from rlqas_chem.search.ucc.prefix_cache import PrefixCache; c = PrefixCache(); c.put((0,1), -1.1); assert c.get((0,1)) == -1.1; assert c.get((0,2)) is None
# --- Tree-GRPO 算法机制专项验证 ---
# 1. 不同 prefix 的缓存条目互不干扰

from rlqas_chem.search.ucc.prefix_cache import PrefixCache; c = PrefixCache(); c.put((0,1), -1.1); c.put((1,0), -1.2); assert c.get((0,1)) == -1.1; assert c.get((1,0)) == -1.2; assert c.get((0,1)) != c.get((1,0)), 'different prefixes returned same cached value'
# 2. 运行足够 episodes 后缓存有条目写入（size > 0）

from rlqas_chem.rl.tree_grpo_agent import TreeGRPOAgent; from rlqas_chem.search.ucc.environment import UCCSearchEnv; from rlqas_chem.molecule.processor import process_molecule; mol = process_molecule('H2', 0.74, 'UCC'); env = UCCSearchEnv(mol, config={'max_excitations': 4}); agent = TreeGRPOAgent(env.observation_space, env.action_space, {}); agent.train_one_group(env); assert agent.prefix_cache.size() > 0, 'prefix_cache is empty after train_one_group — caching not working'
# 3. 多组训练后累计 cache hits > 0（缓存被实际命中）

from rlqas_chem.rl.tree_grpo_agent import TreeGRPOAgent; from rlqas_chem.search.ucc.environment import UCCSearchEnv; from rlqas_chem.molecule.processor import process_molecule; mol = process_molecule('H2', 0.74, 'UCC'); env = UCCSearchEnv(mol, config={'max_excitations': 4}); agent = TreeGRPOAgent(env.observation_space, env.action_space, {'group_size': 16}); [agent.train_one_group(env) for _ in range(3)]; assert agent.prefix_cache.hits() > 0, f'cache hits=0 after 3 groups with group_size=16 — prefix reuse not occurring'
# 4. train_one_group 返回包含 cache_hits 字段

from rlqas_chem.rl.tree_grpo_agent import TreeGRPOAgent; from rlqas_chem.search.ucc.environment import UCCSearchEnv; from rlqas_chem.molecule.processor import process_molecule; mol = process_molecule('H2', 0.74, 'UCC'); env = UCCSearchEnv(mol, config={'max_excitations': 4}); agent = TreeGRPOAgent(env.observation_space, env.action_space, {}); info = agent.train_one_group(env); assert 'cache_hits' in info, f'train_one_group result missing cache_hits key: {list(info.keys())}'

userStories.title: Double-DQN: Double Deep Q-Network with Replay Buffer
userStories.description: Implement DoubleDQNAgent — a sample-efficient DQN variant that decouples action selection (online network) from value evaluation (target network). The replay buffer reuses past transitions, reducing the number of VQE calls needed. Applicable to HEA and Hybrid search. BenchRL-QAS (2025) shows DQN variants outperform PPO in VQE circuit search.
implementation: self.target_q_net: deepcopy of q_net (frozen, updated periodically)
self.replay_buffer: circular buffer of (state, action, reward, next_state, done)
self.update_count: step counter for target network sync
Epsilon-greedy: with prob epsilon sample random action,
next_action = argmax(q_net(next_state))        # online net selects action
next_q = target_q_net(next_state)[next_action] # target net evaluates value
Decay epsilon: epsilon = max(epsilon_end, epsilon * epsilon_decay)
If env is None, raise ValueError (DQN needs env for step-by-step interaction)
Run step-by-step: obs = env.reset(); for each step: act, store, update_step
save(path) / load(path): save/load q_net and target_q_net state_dicts + epsilon
Solution: UCCSearchController and HEASearchController should pass env to learn().
Check how existing DQNAgent handles this — follow the same pattern.
If the existing DQNAgent already solves this, replicate its approach exactly.
acceptanceCriteria: bash rlqas_acceptance_system/run_acceptance.sh --agent double_dqn exits with code 0
from rlqas_chem.rl import DoubleDQNAgent
from rlqas_chem.rl.agent_factory import AgentFactory; assert 'double_dqn' in AgentFactory.supported_agents()
import rlqas_chem; r = rlqas_chem.search('H2', 0.74, ansatz_type='UCC', agent_type='double_dqn', n_episodes=20); assert r['best_energy'] < -1.0
import rlqas_chem; r = rlqas_chem.search('H2', 0.74, ansatz_type='HEA', agent_type='double_dqn', n_episodes=20); assert r.get('best_circuit') is not None
# --- Double-DQN 算法机制专项验证 ---
# 1. epsilon 初始值接近 1.0，训练后发生衰减

from rlqas_chem.rl.double_dqn_agent import DoubleDQNAgent; from rlqas_chem.search.ucc.environment import UCCSearchEnv; from rlqas_chem.molecule.processor import process_molecule; mol = process_molecule('H2', 0.74, 'UCC'); env = UCCSearchEnv(mol, config={'max_excitations': 4}); agent = DoubleDQNAgent(env.observation_space, env.action_space, {}); eps_init = agent.epsilon; assert eps_init >= 0.9, f'epsilon_start={eps_init}, expected ~1.0'; agent.learn(total_timesteps=200, env=env); assert agent.epsilon < eps_init, f'epsilon did not decay after training: {eps_init} -> {agent.epsilon}'
# 2. target_q_net 与 q_net 权重不同步（target net 延迟更新）

from rlqas_chem.rl.double_dqn_agent import DoubleDQNAgent; from rlqas_chem.search.ucc.environment import UCCSearchEnv; from rlqas_chem.molecule.processor import process_molecule; import torch; mol = process_molecule('H2', 0.74, 'UCC'); env = UCCSearchEnv(mol, config={'max_excitations': 4}); agent = DoubleDQNAgent(env.observation_space, env.action_space, {'target_update_freq': 1000}); agent.learn(total_timesteps=50, env=env); q_params = list(agent.q_net.parameters()); t_params = list(agent.target_q_net.parameters()); differs = any(not torch.equal(q, t) for q, t in zip(q_params, t_params)); assert differs, 'q_net and target_q_net are identical after 50 steps — target net may be updating every step'
# 3. replay buffer 在训练后有数据（transition 被存入）

from rlqas_chem.rl.double_dqn_agent import DoubleDQNAgent; from rlqas_chem.search.ucc.environment import UCCSearchEnv; from rlqas_chem.molecule.processor import process_molecule; mol = process_molecule('H2', 0.74, 'UCC'); env = UCCSearchEnv(mol, config={'max_excitations': 4}); agent = DoubleDQNAgent(env.observation_space, env.action_space, {}); agent.learn(total_timesteps=100, env=env); buf_len = len(agent.replay_buffer); assert buf_len > 0, f'replay_buffer is empty after 100 steps — store() may not be called'
# 4. act() 返回的 info 包含 epsilon 和 q_values 字段

from rlqas_chem.rl.double_dqn_agent import DoubleDQNAgent; from rlqas_chem.search.ucc.environment import UCCSearchEnv; from rlqas_chem.molecule.processor import process_molecule; mol = process_molecule('H2', 0.74, 'UCC'); env = UCCSearchEnv(mol, config={'max_excitations': 4}); agent = DoubleDQNAgent(env.observation_space, env.action_space, {}); obs = env.reset(); action, info = agent.act(obs); assert 'epsilon' in info and 'q_values' in info, f'act() info missing keys: {list(info.keys())}'
